notes: Circuit read from the wiring image: green wire from MKR 1000 pin 2 to breadboard column 3; 220 ohm resistor from column 3 to column 6 (row h); LED anode (bent, longer leg) in column 6 and cathode in column 8; black wire from column 8 to the board GND.
Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention (rows f-j = bank 'b'). The image draws rows j-f above the centre gap, so rows h/i/g map to 'b' bank holes.
Resistor legs are interchangeable; the 220 ohm value comes from the schematic label.
The sketch uses LED_BUILTIN, but the text says the external LED is on pin 2. The wiring follows the diagram (pin 2).
The USB cable to a computer for programming is not shown in the circuit images, so it is not included.
Analog pin A1 is read in the sketch but nothing is connected to it.
